string.text: So, what exactly are you guarding over here?
This is Duty territory - our base. We don't let random people waltz in here, so remember that!
That's how it is around here - those are our rules.
Wait, first answer me one question. Are you the one they pulled out alive from that death truck the other day?
Let’s say I am. What of it?
Then you’d better not stay here for long.
I appreciate your help and will reward you with some supplies, but your presence here creates certain risks for us.
We picked up some strange communications tonight; someone is looking for you.
They were strange, stalker, very strange. I don’t know what kind of faction this is, but for your own sake, I hope you don’t cross paths with them.
Well, thanks for that, at least.

Just know that "Duty" never abandons stakers in peril. Except, right now, after an attack of such scale, we’re in an extremely vulnerable position. If this faction decides to strike the checkpoint... I’m responsible for the lives of my men.
Alright, I get it. I’m leaving.
